answer: Require influence to be earned through jobs attested by unrelated established peers, with each job recorded publicly. A newcomer starts low, not at the zenith: it must accumulate verified work over time before its votes count fully. A copied identity inherits no history, so each fake must restart the slow climb, while a single honest record grows like a vine, branching only through checked work. Keep one small ember of initial trust that can be revoked if peers find duplicates, and cap weight per verified history so bulk copies gain no extra power.
